title: muna course
description: course.json, version 1 of the format: one course, in a folder named after its id.

$schema.description: The format and its version. Must be exactly this URL.

id.description: The course ID, the same as its folder name: lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

version.description: This course's version, MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. Raise it whenever anything in the folder changes: patch for edits, minor for new cards or units, major when a card or unit ID is removed.

title.description: The course title, shown in the app.

language.description: The language of the content, e.g. en or it.

kind.description: mastery: passing a unit's test unlocks the next unit. book: a unit unlocks when the learner marks its chapter as read.

color.description: Optional. The course's colour in the app. Missing means violet.

retired.description: Optional. Card and unit IDs removed from this course. It only ever grows, and no card or unit may use an ID in it.

cardId.description: A permanent card ID: letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'. Never renamed or reused, and unique across the whole repo, including every course's retired list.

explanation.description: Optional. Shown after the answer, whether it was right or wrong.

unit.description: A unit: a chapter, a continent. Its lessons introduce its cards in order.

id.description: A permanent unit ID, unique within the course: lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

title.description: The unit title, shown in the app.

cards.description: The cards, in the order lessons introduce them. Must not end with a learn card.

card.description: A card. Its type decides its other fields.

type.description: learn: teaches one idea. mcq: multiple choice. recall: answer in your own words, then tick the key points. order: put steps in order. map: tap a shape on a map. text: type the answer.

learn.description: Teaches one idea. It comes right before the questions on it and teaches every question after it, up to the next learn card. Not graded or scheduled.

body.description: Inline Markdown: paragraphs separated by a blank line, **bold**, *italic* and `code`. No lists or headings; links are shown as plain text.

choices.description: The choices, at least 2, shown in this order.

answer.description: The index of the correct choice, counting from 0.

recall.description: A why or how question. The learner answers in their own words, then ticks the key points they covered: under half is Again, all of them is Good, anything between is Hard.

keyPoints.description: The key points of a good answer, at least 1. Each should be a short fact the learner can tick yes or no.

order.description: Put the items in order, graded automatically.

items.description: At least 2 distinct items, stored in the correct order. The app shuffles them.

map.description: Tap the right shape on a map, graded automatically.
A GeoJSON file in this course's folder, without the extension: "world" means world.geojson next to course.json.

feature.description: The properties.id of the shape to tap. It must be in the map, and not marked "quizzable": false.

text-card.description: Type the answer, graded automatically. Case and accents are ignored.

answers.description: Every accepted answer, at least 1, e.g. other spellings.
